title: adaptive intrinsic-dimension Mirror allocation
status: PROMISING (aligned-only fresh storage/quality gates passed; no compute claim)
hypothesis: A validation-selected prefix of shared 2D Mirror planes allocates fewer serialized bytes than adaptive random-subspace coefficient vectors across tasks with intrinsic dimensions 2, 4, and 8, while matching held-out quality.
physical_object: shared 16D linear predictor and paid random orthonormal 16x8 task-update basis
mirror_coordinate: per-task FP16 angle for each active 2D pair plus an explicit active-dimension address
logical_multiplicity: 48 task-conditioned predictors with variable active intrinsic dimensions; task count is not independent capacity
controls: adaptive PA33 random-subspace least-squares FP32 codes
adaptive direct FP16 coefficient codes on same basis

data.mirror_angle_solver: four pairwise coordinate-descent sweeps over the frozen grid, initialized at zero; each pair is fitted against the support residual after subtracting current estimates for the other active pairs
data.teacher: task deltas occupy the first d coordinates in the paid random basis, with d balanced over 2,4,8; each active pair has its registered shared radius and a task-specific uniform angle
data.dimension_selection: fit on support; select smallest d in [2,4,8] with validation normalized MSE <= 1e-4; evaluate once on test

selection.tunable: none; dimensions, precision, support/validation/test sizes, threshold and grid are frozen

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: NPZ-compatible fixed-timestamp ZIP with uncompressed NPY arrays
paid_objects: full independent weights for upper control

success_gate: Every development seed: adaptive Mirror normalized test MSE <=1e-4; exact minimum dimension selected on >=95% tasks; actual bytes <=90% both adaptive FP16 coefficient control and adaptive SAID; per-dimension quality within 1e-5 absolute normalized MSE of adaptive FP16 control.
failure_gate: Any aligned development byte, quality, or dimension-selection gate fails; or a simple control matches Mirror within the registered actual-byte margin.

fresh.open_condition: only if all development gates pass

boundaries: teacher lies on shared fixed-radius polar planes
task IDs supplied; no learned router
